intro: The 5x symbol is Wild and substitutes for ordinary symbols in winning combinations. One 5x Wild multiplies the ordinary combination payout by five, while two such Wilds multiply it by 25, except for a combination of three 5x symbols.
The game also uses Scatter: two or more Scatters anywhere on the reels produce a separate win. The official page does not state a separate Free Spins or respin mechanic.
playn-go-5x-magic.editorial: 5x Magic is a compact classic setup with its entire mechanic concentrated in one Wild. Its value depends on the number of 5x symbols within a combination rather than a separate bonus.

features.title: 5x Wild and Scatter
features.description: One 5x Wild applies x5 to the ordinary payout, two apply x25, while two or more Scatters produce a separate scatter win.

features.title: Wild x5 and x25
features.description: One 5x Wild multiplies the ordinary payline win by five; two such Wilds in a combination multiply it by twenty-five.

features.title: Scatter without a separate bonus
features.description: Two or more Scatters award a separate payout; the official game does not state independent Free Spins or Re-Spins.

intro: Bamboo Ways starts with only the bottom three rows open. Each winning cascade or Instant Prize opens another row until the grid has expanded; a new ordinary spin starts this progression again.
Mystery Symbols can reveal an Expanding Wild, a Wild converter or Golden Bamboo. In Free Spins, collecting Scatters increases the bonus level and boosts Golden Bamboo payouts.
push-gaming-bamboo-ways.editorial: The main difference from Big Bamboo is that Bamboo Ways expands the grid one row at a time through cascades, rather than building the entire bonus around Mystery Stacks and a wheel.

features.title: Opening new rows
features.description: Each cascade or instant prize unlocks an additional row, starting from the bottom three.

features.title: Wild Converter
features.description: Every ordinary symbol of a selected type turns into Wild, together with the converter.

features.title: Golden Bamboo and Free Spins
features.description: Mystery symbols reveal Golden Bamboo; Scatters in the bonus raise the multiplier level and change the set of low-paying symbols.

intro: 15 Coins Grand Platinum Edition adds a separate Cash Out to the familiar Hold the Jackpot and Cash Infinity combination. Cash labels allow payouts in the base game rather than only at the end of the bonus series.
Values are still collected across fifteen reels for a bonus with a Grand Jackpot of up to 2500x. Chance Level controls how often it appears but does not replace the separate Cash Out mechanic.
wazdan-15-coins-grand-platinum-edition.editorial: Compared with Gold Edition, Platinum is distinguished by the addition of Cash Out and a higher verified Grand Jackpot limit, rather than simply a change in symbol colours.

features.title: Cash Out
features.description: Accumulating labels offer a way to receive cash values while still in the base mode.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: The bonus series collects cash symbols on 15 reels with a Grand Jackpot of up to 2500x.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Chance Level
features.description: Persistent symbols strengthen a future bonus, while the Chance Level setting changes the chance of entering it.

intro: In 3 Hot Teapots, three teapots fill with progress symbols and unlock Hold & Win.
Each meter activates its own enhancement.
3-oaks-gaming-3-hot-teapots.editorial: When all teapots are filled, Super Bonus starts with all three features.

features.title: Three teapots
features.description: Red, blue and purple teapots trigger Hold & Win.

features.title: Boost, Double and Multi
features.description: Boost increases values, Double opens a second grid, and Multi places multipliers.

features.title: Super Bonus
features.description: All three filled meters activate the features together.

intro: Frenzy Clusters is a cluster slot where a win starts with four adjacent matching symbols, while Rocket, Book and Sphere clear different parts of the grid.
Stone cells can open during cascades, and the two bonuses differ in their available playing area and accumulating multipliers above the grid.
bgaming-frenzy-clusters.editorial: Frenzy Clusters does not link its mathematics to the chosen hero: the character changes the game’s presentation. Symbol removal, opening stones and the difference between Free Spins and purchased Mega Free Spins matter more to the outcome.

features.title: Rocket, Book and Sphere
features.description: Rocket removes a horizontal or vertical line, Book clears a 3×3 square, and Sphere removes all copies of a randomly selected symbol type.

features.title: Stones and clusters
features.description: Groups of four symbols pay; wins can open stone cells, expanding the grid and revealing hidden multipliers.

features.title: Free Spins with a growing multiplier
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger the bonus: each Scatter adds x1 to the overall multiplier, while three multipliers beneath stones are revealed as play progresses.

features.title: Mega Free Spins and Mystery Buy
features.description: Purchased Mega Free Spins open the entire grid immediately and start with three additional multipliers; Mystery Buy selects a random bonus through one of five portals.

intro: Hell Hot 1000 adds Pick ’Em Game, Pile Feature and Jackpot Collecting to a classic fruit base game.
Wild can appear stacked, while a separate Pick ’Em provides the main bonus departure from the base payline game.
endorphina-hell-hot-1000.editorial: Hell Hot 1000 retains the classic fruit-slot structure but adds accumulation through the Pile Feature and a separate Pick ’Em instead of a complex multi-stage Hold & Win.

features.title: Pick ’Em, Pile and Jackpot Collecting
features.description: Three bonus mechanics work on top of a classic fruit slot without changing its underlying payline structure.

features.title: Stacked Wild and Scatter
features.description: Wild can land in stacks in the base game and substitutes for ordinary symbols, but not Scatter. Five winning Scatters award a special payout according to the paytable; this does not represent the slot’s overall maximum win.

features.title: Pick ’Em and Pile Feature
features.description: Pick ’Em Game offers an independent pick mechanic, while the Pile Feature handles accumulating progress. The developer adds Jackpot Collecting separately on top of the ordinary fruit payline game.

intro: Match-2-Win requires the left and right halves of a symbol to match on linked reel pairs.
A complete Multiplier Pair becomes a Global Multiplier, while Top-Shelf Trouble adds a Bash Bar capable of creating new matching pairs.
hacksaw-gaming-booze-bash.editorial: Booze Bash centres on assembling pairs from symbol halves rather than ordinary paylines; in the bonuses, the Bash Bar intervenes in the grid and creates additional matches.

features.title: Match-2-Win on reel pairs
features.description: A winning Pair consists of the left and right halves of the same symbol on one row. Halves can connect only between reels 1–2, 3–4 and 5–6.

features.title: Multiplier Pairs
features.description: An x half and a number half create a Global Multiplier of up to x20, applying to every win in the spin. This multiplier requires a complete pair, just like ordinary prize symbols.

features.title: Bash Bar and three bonus variants
features.description: One FS Pair awards Guilty as Gin; two award Top-Shelf Trouble with a Bash Bar that completes pairs; three award Hell’s Happy Hour, where the Bash Bar can also reveal Special Symbols.

intro: Lucky 7 Wild appears on reels 1, 3 and 5, while Double Lucky 7 Wild on reels 2 and 4 occupies two adjacent positions. Two Double Wilds make combinations of up to seven matching symbols possible.

Three Pandora’s Box Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger 7 Free Spins. On each spin, one of the seven sins becomes a Sticky Expanded Sin on the central reel, while the overall multiplier grows from x1 to x7.
playn-go-7-sins.editorial: 7 Sins uses a fixed seven-spin structure as a stepped progression: each spin changes the Sticky Expanded Sin and increases the multiplier at the same time. With two Scatters, Second Chance offers an attempt to find the third or receive an instant prize.

features.title: Double Lucky 7 and Sticky Expanded Sins
features.description: Double Wild occupies two positions, Pandora’s Box triggers 7 Free Spins, and each spin brings a Sticky Expanded Sin and a growing x1–x7 multiplier.

features.title: Pandora and seven Free Spins
features.description: Three Pandora Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 award seven spins; a Sticky Expanded Sin appears in the central area.

features.title: x1–x7 progression and Second Chance
features.description: The overall multiplier increases on every Free Spin, while two Scatters in the base game can unlock Second Chance for a third symbol.

intro: Big Bam-book uses Mystery Bamboo Symbols that reveal ordinary payouts or a golden Mystery variant. Golden Mystery Bamboo provides a separate route to instant prizes and bonus Scatters.

Three, four or five Scatters trigger 8, 12 or 15 Free Spins. Additional Scatters in the bonus fill the Golden Mystery multiplier meter, but that multiplier applies only to Instant Prizes, not to all payline wins.
push-gaming-big-bam-book.editorial: Big Bam-book’s key distinction is its targeted instant-prize multiplier. It is different from the Lucky Bamboo with bronze and diamond frames in Big Bamboo 2.

features.title: Mystery Reveal
features.description: Bamboo Symbols reveal an ordinary symbol or Golden Mystery Bamboo.

features.title: Golden Mystery Bamboo
features.description: In the special mode, golden Mystery symbols can reveal additional Scatters and Instant Prizes.

features.title: Progressive Free Spins
features.description: 3/4/5 Scatters award 8/12/15 spins and different starting levels on the bonus meter.

intro: 16 Coins moves the series to a square 4×4 layout: it has sixteen separate reels and no conventional payline win calculation.

Wins come from collecting cash values in Hold the Jackpot. Cash Infinity preserves certain symbols between the base game and bonus, while the original 16 Coins Grand Jackpot is limited to a verified 1000x.
wazdan-16-coins.editorial: This is the original version of the sixteen-reel branch: Cash Out and a 5000x Grand Jackpot belong to the later x5000 version, not to 16 Coins itself.

features.title: Square 4×4 grid
features.description: Sixteen reels form positions for collecting cash in the bonus, rather than sixteen payline columns.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: Cash symbols remain until the next bonus and boost the final values.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: The main game outcome is linked to held bonus symbols; the stated maximum is 1000x.

intro: In 3 Jewel Crowns, three crown colours fill their own meters. Full meters unlock seven free spins with the corresponding enhancements.
Extra Spins adds another seven spins, Jackpot opens a jackpot mode, and Double Reels activates a second grid; all features can combine.
3-oaks-gaming-3-jewel-crowns.editorial: In 3 Jewel Crowns, the main reference is the set of filled meters rather than an individual crown: it determines whether extra spins, jackpots and a second grid are added.

features.title: Crowns unlock seven free spins
features.description: Green, red and blue crowns fill their own meters. Filled meters trigger seven free spins and activate the matching enhancements.

features.title: Extra Spins, Jackpot and Double Reels
features.description: Extra Spins adds another seven free spins, Jackpot unlocks MINI, MAJOR and GRAND, and Double Reels activates a second playing grid. All three features can work together.

features.title: Growing jackpots
features.description: Each crown that lands increases a random jackpot by the current stake, up to its limit. In Jackpot Prize mode, the values grow: Minor up to 50x, Major up to 250x, and Grand up to 5,000x the stake.

intro: Fruit Million Respin retains the fruit slot’s hundred paylines, but an Expanding Wild on reels 2–4 can expand, pay combinations and trigger an extra spin.
New Wilds during respins extend the series, and their x1, x2, x3 and x5 multipliers add together until the whole sequence ends.
bgaming-fruit-million-respin.editorial: These are not conventional Free Spins: the expanded Wild remains on its reel specifically during respins. BGaming’s page gives conflicting overall maximum wins (x3000 in the table and x5000 in the FAQ), so the disputed value is not asserted here.

features.title: Expanding Wild on reels 2–4
features.description: Each Wild on the central reels expands to cover its entire reel and can create winning combinations.

features.title: Sequence of up to three respins
features.description: A Wild expansion triggers one Respin. A new Wild during the series extends it; up to three consecutive respins are possible.

features.title: Additive Wild multipliers
features.description: Each expanded Wild brings a random x1, x2, x3 or x5; the values add together and apply to the respin sequence’s win.

features.title: Stacked Symbols and two Scatters
features.description: Stacks of matching symbols occupy part or all of a reel. The first Scatter can land on any reel; the second can land only on 1, 3 or 5.

intro: MooFo combines three separate bonus mechanics: Milk ’Em, Moo Hold and MooFo UFO.
Coloured cow Tokens cover other symbols, and after they leave, the revealed positions may complete a winning combination.
endorphina-moofo.editorial: MooFo does not reduce its bonuses to one mode: Milk ’Em, Moo Hold and the UFO round work as different branches, while the Token mechanic changes the base spins between them.

features.title: Milk ’Em, Moo Hold and MooFo UFO
features.description: Three bonus games complement Token Symbols, Wild and a separate Risk Game. MooFo combines three separate bonus mechanics: Milk ’Em, Moo Hold and MooFo UFO.

features.title: Cow Tokens and Dog Wild
features.description: Green, red and purple Cow Tokens cover positions in the base game and Free Games, revealing symbols when they disappear. The dog Wild appears on reels 2–5 and substitutes for ordinary symbols.

features.title: Milk ’Em, Moo Hold and UFO
features.description: Milk ’Em, Moo Hold and MooFo UFO are three different bonus games, not names for one Hold & Win mode. The developer also separately notes a classic card-based Risk Game and Free Games.

intro: All wins from a spin collect in the Total Win Bar, after which Bomb Multipliers add together and apply to the total.
Cascading Dynamite Bomb increases its value with each new cascade, while Bombastic Fantastic guarantees a Bomb Multiplier on every Free Spin.
hacksaw-gaming-bouncy-bombs.editorial: Bouncy Bombs separates the win itself from its enhancement: the Total Win Bar is formed first, then the whole amount is multiplied by a set of Bomb Multipliers that can grow during cascades.

features.title: Total Win Bar and combined Bombs
features.description: Cascade payouts collect in the Total Win Bar. If the spin has a win, all Bomb Multiplier values are added together first and then multiply the total amount.

features.title: Three bomb types
features.description: Normal Bomb immediately shows x2–x4, Revealing Bomb reveals a random value when it explodes, and Cascading Dynamite Bomb doubles its own multiplier with each new cascade.

features.title: Bombastic and Bombastic Fantastic
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger ten Bombastic Spins with more frequent effects. Four FS symbols award ten Bombastic Fantastic Spins, with a guaranteed Bomb Multiplier on every spin.

intro: Ace of Spades is a classic three-reel slot with one central payline. Only a combination on that line produces a win; blank positions do not pay.

The Ace of Spades symbol acts as Wild and substitutes for other symbols. One Ace in a winning combination doubles the coin count; two Aces multiply it by four; three Aces award the maximum combination stated by the provider.
playn-go-ace-of-spades.editorial: Ace of Spades has almost none of the modern feature layers: its mathematics centres on one payline and a Wild multiplier. This makes the profile a useful contrast to later Play’n GO games with bonus grids and progression.

features.title: Single Payline and Ace Wild
features.description: The game uses one central payline; Ace substitutes for ordinary symbols and multiplies winning coins by x2 with one Ace or x4 with two.

features.title: Central Payline
features.description: This classic three-reel slot pays only on the central line, without bonus cascades.

features.title: Ace Wild x2 and x4
features.description: Ace substitutes for other symbols; one in a combination doubles the coin win, two quadruple it, and three have a special payout.

intro: The original Big Bamboo centres on Mystery Stacks. They reveal ordinary symbols, Wild or Golden Bamboo; the golden variant triggers a separate respin with Instant Prizes, multipliers and a Collector.
In Free Spins, the player can accept the offered spins or use the Gamble Wheel to seek a stronger setup. Additional symbol transformations change the payout composition before the series starts.
push-gaming-big-bamboo.editorial: This version should be distinguished from Big Bamboo 2: the original relies on Mystery Stacks, Golden Bamboo Respin and a gamble wheel, rather than multi-level Persistent Frames.

features.title: Mystery Stack
features.description: Mystery stacks reveal ordinary symbols, Wild or Golden Bamboo.

features.title: Golden Bamboo
features.description: The special respin can award an Instant Prize, Multiplier, Collector and Scatter.

features.title: Gamble Wheel
features.description: Before Free Spins, the current bonus setup can be given up for a gamble on an improved one.

intro: 16 Coins Grand Gold Edition retains the original’s sixteen independent reels but increases the Hold the Jackpot win potential to 2000x the stake.
Cash Infinity accumulates cash values, Sticky to Infinity can hold Mystery Symbols until the bonus, and Chance Level increases the chance of entering Hold the Jackpot.
wazdan-16-coins-grand-gold-edition.editorial: The main difference from Platinum and x5000 is that Gold focuses on enhanced Hold the Jackpot and symbol accumulation, without those versions’ separate Cash Out.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 2000x
features.description: Hold the Jackpot in this version has its own prize limit, different from the original.

features.title: Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols can stay in their positions until the next bonus ends.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Chance Level
features.description: Cash symbols carry into the bonus, while an additional setting affects the probability of triggering it.

intro: In 3 Lucky Sparks, Dragon Collect gathers Coin Symbol values.
Three firework meters unlock eight free spins.
3-oaks-gaming-3-lucky-sparks.editorial: Rise expands the grid, while Boost allows Collect to appear on the first and fifth reels.

features.title: Dragon Collect
features.description: The symbol on the fifth reel gathers visible coin values.

features.title: Extra, Rise and Boost
features.description: Extra adds free spins, Rise opens two rows, and Boost expands the Collect positions.

features.title: Super Free Spins
features.description: The purchased Super mode guarantees all three features.

intro: Johnny vs Chicken brings the heroes of Wild West and Chicken Rush together in a Multiplier Duel: a VS Symbol becomes an Expanding Wild after one fighter randomly wins.
Duel multipliers reach x500; three Scatters unlock ten Free Spins with the possibility of adding further sets of ten spins.
bgaming-johnny-vs-chicken.editorial: In Johnny vs Chicken, the duel winner is selected randomly, so the x500 multiplier does not promise that payout in every bonus. Purchased Flaming Shot and Inferno Shot differ through Sticky Expanding Wilds, which the base game does not trigger.

features.title: Multiplier Duel from a VS Symbol
features.description: Both characters receive random multipliers from the x2–x500 range; after the fight, the winner becomes an Expanding Wild on the corresponding reel.

features.title: Adding Wild multipliers
features.description: When several Expanding Wilds contribute to one winning combination, their multipliers add together.

features.title: Ten Free Spins and retrigger
features.description: Three Scatters trigger ten free spins; each new set of three Scatters within the mode adds another ten.

features.title: Hot Shot, Flaming Shot, Inferno Shot
features.description: Purchased Hot Shot provides ordinary Free Spins; Flaming Shot adds random Sticky Wilds, while Inferno Shot guarantees one from the first spin.

intro: Zalatar combines Hold & Win, Jackpot Collecting, Multipliers and a Pile Feature with three different piles.
Three Question Mark Scatters can trigger Mystery Pick ’Em, while each pile leads to its own Hold & Win variant.
endorphina-zalatar.editorial: Zalatar’s main structure revolves around three piles: their progress unlocks different Hold & Win scenarios, while Mystery Pick ’Em adds a separate route through Scatter Symbols.

features.title: Three piles and Mystery Pick ’Em
features.description: The Pile Feature splits Hold & Win into three variants, while three Question Mark Scatters unlock Mystery Pick ’Em.

features.title: Three Piles and Hold & Win
features.description: Three independent Pile accumulators unlock different Hold & Win variants. The bonus triggered depends on the activated pile; Collect and Multipliers complement the cash-value mechanic.

features.title: Mystery Pick ’Em and Token Coins
features.description: Three Question Mark Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 can unlock Mystery Pick ’Em. Coloured Token Coins hide symbols, then reveal them and may complete a combination, independently of Hold & Win.

intro: A winning VS Symbol expands across its entire reel and turns it into a Wild DuelReel, followed by a duel for a multiplier.
Bounty DuelReel allows the Bounty Hunter to continue duelling after a victory and add several won multipliers together for one reel.
hacksaw-gaming-bullets-and-bounty.editorial: Bullets and Bounty makes the duel part of the reel itself: VS first turns it Wild, and the fight’s outcome then determines the multiplier for all wins on that reel.

features.title: Outlaw and Bounty DuelReels
features.description: A winning VS expands the reel into a Wild DuelReel and triggers a multiplier duel. The Bounty Hunter can win up to three consecutive duels, adding the values together on one reel.

features.title: True Grit and progressive bounty
features.description: Three FS symbols lead to a choice of True Grit or Gamble. In True Grit, the last multiplier won by the Bounty Hunter becomes the starting value for the next duel.

features.title: Four Shots to Freedom
features.description: Four FS symbols unlock ten Spins with a Bullets & Bounty meter: duel victories add DuelSpins and new VS symbols. Five FS symbols award an enhanced version from the first level.

intro: Linked Reels can activate on any spin, making neighbouring reels show identical symbols. This happens on either reels 4–5 or all of 3–5, followed by one Free Spin.

On this Free Spin, the matching symbol set from the right-hand reels moves left, and a new linked group forms on the right. Character symbols and Safe Wild can appear as Mega Symbols or merge into them from neighbouring stacks.
playn-go-agent-destiny.editorial: Agent Destiny builds its feature around a linked group moving across the grid: the winning structure is not simply copied, but shifts left on the next spin and forms again on the right. Free Spins separately support the continued appearance of matching symbols.

features.title: Linked Reels and Mega Symbols
features.description: Linked reels show matching symbols and trigger a Free Spin that shifts the group, while characters and Safe Wild can form Mega Symbols.

features.title: Linked reels 3–5 or 4–5
features.description: On a random spin, Linked Reels show identical symbols and trigger a separate Free Spin.

features.title: Shifting and Mega Symbols
features.description: The linked group moves left during the Free Spin, a new group forms on the right, and Character and Safe Wild symbols can become Mega Symbols.

intro: Big Bamboo 2 retains Mystery Bamboo but introduces Lucky Bamboo with Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond frames. During the special series, a new Golden Bamboo resets the three remaining spins.
In Free Spins, frames remain on the grid, while Bonus and Extra Spin Symbols fill a meter that replaces low-paying symbols with Mystery symbols and increases rewards.
push-gaming-big-bamboo-2.editorial: The sequel should not be described as a copy of Big Bamboo: persistent Lucky Bamboo frames and their upgrade thresholds form a new accumulation mechanic absent from the original.

features.title: Lucky Bamboo Frames
features.description: Golden Bamboo upgrades frames from Bronze to Diamond, with each level unlocking its own Instant Prize range.

features.title: Free Spins Progression
features.description: New Bonus and Extra Spin Symbols fill the meter for replacing low-paying symbols with Mystery Bamboo.

features.title: Persistent Frames
features.description: Frames earned in Free Spins remain on the grid until the bonus ends.

intro: 16 Coins Grand Platinum Edition uses the same sixteen-position grid but adds Cash Out to Hold the Jackpot and Cash Infinity.

Cash Out produces results outside the main bonus, while the Grand Jackpot of up to 2500x belongs specifically to Platinum Edition. Changing Chance Level remains a separate way to control bonus frequency.
wazdan-16-coins-grand-platinum-edition.editorial: Platinum sits between Gold at 2000x and x5000 at 5000x, but the new Cash Out branch matters more than the numbers: it is more than an extra Hold the Jackpot symbol.

features.title: Cash Out in the base game
features.description: Separate cash labels collect prizes before the bonus respins begin.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 2500x
features.description: The 16-reel grid is used for held cash positions with a verified maximum of 2500x.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Chance Level
features.description: Persistent values add to the bonus; Chance Level changes the probability of it starting.

intro: In 3 Olymp Fortunes, filled pots unlock Hold & Win. Before each bonus game, Super Wheel guarantees an additional reward.
During respins, Extra adds attempts, Multi works with multipliers, and Double opens a second grid.
3-oaks-gaming-3-olymp-fortunes.editorial: In 3 Olymp Fortunes, the trigger outcome depends on both the pots and Super Wheel: the wheel can immediately add bonus symbols, a new feature or a jackpot.

features.title: Three Olympian pots
features.description: One or more filled pots trigger Hold & Win. MINI, MINOR and MAJOR are available in the bonus, while filling the grid awards the Grand Jackpot of 1,000x the stake.

features.title: Extra, Multi and Double
features.description: Extra increases respins to four, Multi adds multipliers to random symbols that multiply together within one cell, and Double opens a second grid and the chance of two Grand Jackpots.

features.title: Super Wheel before the bonus
features.description: Before every bonus game, Super Wheel guarantees a reward: extra bonus symbols, another feature or an instant jackpot.

intro: Miss Cherry Wild Frames revolves around a ten-spin cycle: Special Symbols leave golden Wild Frames that turn into Wilds only on the tenth spin.
Another Special Symbol landing in an existing frame raises the cycle multiplier, but Free Spins use a different mechanic: Sticky Wilds instead of Wild Frames.
bgaming-miss-cherry-wild-frames.editorial: Miss Cherry Wild Frames does not carry its ten-spin cycle into the bonus as ready-made frames: no new frames are created in Free Spins. The base mode accumulates Wild Frames until the tenth spin; the bonus holds sticky Wilds.

features.title: Wild Frames for ten spins
features.description: Special Symbols create frames that remain until the tenth spin, when they turn into Wild Symbols.

features.title: Current-cycle multiplier
features.description: An additional Special inside a frame increases the multiplier by +1; it affects wins until the current ten-spin cycle ends.

features.title: Free Spins with Sticky Wilds
features.description: Three Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 award ten Free Spins. Every Wild that lands stays until the round ends; no new Wild Frames are created.

features.title: Three purchases and Chance x2
features.description: Purchased modes include Free Spins with guaranteed 2×2 or 3×3 Wilds. Chance x2 increases the probability of the ordinary bonus at a higher stake.

intro: Grab ’em collects Cash Symbols, while neighbouring Wild Multiplier Symbols multiply the Cash values in the area around them.
In The Vault and High-Security Vault, positions where Multiplier Symbols land stay active and receive new random multipliers on subsequent Free Spins.
hacksaw-gaming-cash-crew.editorial: Cash Crew links Cash collection to positional multipliers: a coin’s value depends on the Multiplier Symbols nearby, while the bonus keeps activated positions until the series ends.

features.title: Grab ’em and Cash Symbols
features.description: Cash pays only when Grab ’em appears. Neighbouring Wild Multipliers boost Cash within a 3×3 area; multiple multipliers multiply together for the affected Cash.

features.title: The Vault: active positions
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger six Spins: each cell where a Multiplier lands stays active and receives a new random multiplier on subsequent Spins. Stopwatch adds 1–6 Spins.

features.title: High-Security Vault
features.description: Four FS symbols unlock nine Spins with the same active multiplier positions, but Cash Symbols here have a minimum value of x5. Stopwatch can also extend the series.

intro: Wins form from clusters of five or more matching symbols. After a cluster pays, it is removed, new symbols fall from above, and cascades continue until no new wins remain.

Agent symbols contributing to wins accumulate: six unlock the corresponding Agent Feature. White Rabbit can unlock it immediately. Three Keys in one spin trigger Queen’s Heart Free Spin, where all four Agent Features work in sequence and a 3x2 Mega Wild appears at the end.
playn-go-agent-of-hearts.editorial: Agent of Hearts uses cascades both for repeat wins and to charge four different Agent Features. Queen’s Heart Free Spin combines them into one guaranteed scenario and ends the round with a large Mega Wild.

features.title: Agent Features and Queen’s Heart
features.description: Cluster wins charge four Agent Features, White Rabbit can unlock a feature immediately, and three Keys trigger a single Free Spin with all four features and a 3x2 Mega Wild.

features.title: Clusters and four agents
features.description: Five adjacent matching symbols trigger a cascade, while six Agent Symbols that contributed to wins charge a separate ability.

features.title: White Rabbit and Queen’s Heart
features.description: White Rabbit can activate an Agent Feature immediately, while three Keys trigger a Free Spin with all four abilities and a final 3×2 Mega Wild.

intro: Big Bite revolves around two orcas at the edges of the grid. Orcas on the first and fifth reels collect Fish and Jackpot prizes from the three central reels when the corresponding symbols land together.

Three Bonus Symbols unlock ten Free Spins; four provide an initial x3 multiplier, and five provide x10. In the bonus, the grid changes to 5×6, while the Orca meter rises after every four orcas caught.
push-gaming-big-bite.editorial: The original Big Bite focuses on collecting Fish and Jackpots across five reels. It has none of the dividing Hot Zones from the Push Ways version, whose grid and jackpots should not be transferred to the original.

features.title: Orca collection
features.description: Orcas on reels 1 and 5 collect Fish and Jackpot values on reels 2–4 when they land together.

features.title: Three entry variants
features.description: Three, four and five Bonus Symbols each award ten Free Spins, but with different starting multipliers.

features.title: Orca meter
features.description: Four orca appearances raise the multiplier level and add bonus spins.

intro: 16 Coins x5000 starts Hold the Jackpot with three respins, and each new cash symbol resets the counter to three. Filling the entire grid can award the Grand Jackpot of 5000x the stake.
This version adds Cash Out labels with a countdown: they collect Bonus Symbol values and finally pay the accumulated amount with a percentage boost, which the provider limits to 300 percent.
wazdan-16-coins-x5000.editorial: The x5000 formula does not apply to 16 Coins Gold and Platinum: it has its own jackpot limit, a four-level jackpot system and Cash Out with a countdown.

features.title: Three resetting respins
features.description: In Hold the Jackpot, each new symbol resets the counter to three attempts.

features.title: Cash Out with a timer
features.description: A label collects values and pays them with the specified percentage boost when its countdown expires.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 5000x
features.description: Filling all 16 positions can award the maximum verified Grand Jackpot of 5000x.

intro: In 3 Pots of Egypt, six gold coins trigger Hold & Win, while coloured special coins fill three pot meters alongside them.
These meters activate Collect, Boost and Multi, so the combination of coins that land changes the bonus scenario itself.
3-oaks-gaming-3-pots-of-egypt.editorial: In 3 Pots of Egypt, which pots have filled before the trigger matters: Collect gathers values, Boost adds values to every symbol, and Multi multiplies values by up to x5.

features.title: Six gold coins
features.description: Six or more gold coins trigger Hold & Win with respins. MINI, MINOR and MAJOR can land within it.

features.title: Collect, Boost and Multi
features.description: Blue, red and green special coins fill the pot meters: Collect gathers values, Boost adds a random value to all symbols, and Multi multiplies all values by up to x5.

features.title: Mystery Symbol and Lucky Spin
features.description: During respins, Mystery can reveal one of three enhancements or a jackpot. Lucky Spin also triggers Hold & Win; filling the grid can award the Grand Jackpot of 2,000x the stake.

intro: Money Maker is a three-reel stepper with just one horizontal payline. A complete banknote made from matching parts is required for a payout.
The highest-denomination banknote on the visible grid awards x1000; after a win, the amount can be risked separately in Gamble Round (Heads or Tails).
bgaming-money-maker.editorial: Money Maker has no described Free Spins, cascades or Bonus Buy. It is deliberately simple, with one payline and an optional Gamble after a payout as its actual additional mechanic.

features.title: One payline and a complete banknote
features.description: Three reels assemble coloured banknotes on the central line. Only a matching banknote pays; the most valuable awards x1000.

features.title: Heads or Tails Gamble
features.description: After a base win, guessing a coin side is available. Success doubles the current amount, which can be collected or wagered again.

features.title: Gamble limit
features.description: Repeated guesses are allowed until the win reaches a quarter of the maximum possible payout; this limit is not RTP.

features.title: Autoplay and Quick Spin
features.description: Automatic series are set by the number of spins, while Quick Spin speeds up the animation without changing the payline count or payout mechanic.

intro: A horizontal CHAOS word formed by five low-paying symbols triggers EPIC DROP™, turning them into Glitch Dogs and adding Crazy Multipliers to the Reel Multiplier.
The Korrupted K9 introduces Chaos Upgrade, which boosts nearby Crazy Multipliers and Glitch Dogs before they add to the Reel Multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-chaos-crew-3.editorial: The third instalment shifts the mechanic’s centre to the overall Reel Multiplier: Glitch Dogs and Crazy Multipliers increase it directly, while Chaos Upgrade can first enhance a whole group of symbols.

features.title: CHAOS and Epic Drop
features.description: Five low-paying symbols spelling CHAOS horizontally trigger EPIC DROP: Glitch Dogs move around the grid and turn into Crazy Multipliers for the Reel Multiplier.

features.title: Ctrl + Alt + Chaos
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger a bonus with three refilling lives. A new Glitch Dog or Crazy Multiplier increases the Reel Multiplier and resets the life count.

features.title: The Korrupted K9 and Epic Glitch
features.description: Four FS symbols provide Chaos Upgrade, boosting multipliers in a 3×3 area; five FS symbols award Hidden Epic with a full grid of Crazy Multipliers, an Upgrade and a Glitch Dog at the start.

intro: A cluster of four or more matching symbols creates a win. Winning symbols are removed, the grid refills, and cascades continue until a spin produces no new cluster win.

On a non-winning spin, one of four realities can randomly open: Insane Asylum unifies high-paying symbols, Dungeon turns low-paying symbols into high-paying ones, Chamber of Horrors leaves Wilds after destroying symbols, and Temptation Room adds a Wild and unifies symbols. The Charge Meter leads to extra Wilds and Free Spins.
playn-go-alice-cooper-and-the-tome-of-ma.editorial: Alice Cooper and the Tome of Madness combines ordinary cluster cascades with four different ways to rescue a non-winning spin. The Charge Meter connects these episodes into a longer progression towards Free Spins and extra Wilds.

features.title: Four Realities and Charge Meter
features.description: Four random realities reshape the grid in different ways on a non-win, while the Charge Meter unlocks extra Wilds, Free Spins and an overcharge multiplier.

features.title: Four alternative realities
features.description: Insane Asylum and Dungeon change ordinary symbols; Chamber of Horrors and Temptation Room offer ways to enhance Wilds.

features.title: Charge Meter and cascades
features.description: A cluster of four symbols pays with a cascade, while a special meter brings Free Spins and additional Wilds closer.
